decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (029-PE-XX-99-DR-A-9911 Rev P03 (received 08/08/2013)
029-PE-XX-ZZ-DR-A-0802 Rev P02 (received 05/09/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The temporary building and hardstanding hereby permitted shall be removed from the site and the ground returned to its former condition within 3 years of the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The cycle storage shall be moved in accordance with the approved plans prior to the occupation of the building hereby approved.  The cycle storage shall remain in this form for as long as the development remains in existence.
description: Temporary relocation of existing resources block and installation of temporary hardstanding
